_comment: The bench fleet. Each entry pairs a queue with the card authored for its
own imageable area and the blob captured after configuring it by hand.
All three have to travel together: a card authored for another device is
clipped or rescaled, and an unpinned job inherits whatever the driver UI
was last set to. See CLAUDE.MD, Verified 18, 43, 47 and 56.
Read by stress_all.py and by the hub's /demo route. Paths use forward
slashes on purpose; Windows accepts them and JSON does not have to escape
